title: Great Smoky Mountains Trip Planner Printable, Smokies Itinerary 3 5 7 Days, Gatlinburg Travel Guide PDF, Packing List, National Park Trip
description:
America's most-visited national park is easy to reach and easy to get wrong: trailheads fill by mid-morning, some roads close for half the year, and the weather on the ridges has little to do with the weather in Gatlinburg. This guide covers everything around the hikes, so you arrive with a plan.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- When to go: every season, crowd levels and seasonal road openings
- Getting there and around: airports, the three entrances and 2026 parking tag rules
- Where to stay: Gatlinburg, Pigeon Forge, Townsend, Cherokee, Bryson City, campgrounds and LeConte Lodge
- 3, 5 and 7-day itineraries built around the park's 10 best day hikes
- Beyond hiking: Cades Cove, Roaring Fork, Newfound Gap, elk, fireflies and roadside waterfalls
- Six safety rules for the Smokies
- A fillable packing list and trip planner, with day-by-day and budget pages

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions, print-ready
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Information current as of September 2026. Photos via Wikimedia Commons with credits in the guide. Conditions change, so always follow current park guidance on nps.gov/grsm. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
